questions.promptEn:
[01-06] 다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오. (교재 p.158)
Hi! I am a plastic duck and I am a bath toy. But look! I am not in a bathroom. ⓐ난 대양 한가운데 있어. How did I get here?
I was from a factory ⓑ ______ other ducks. People made us ⓒ ______ plastic because it is light and lasts long. People put us in boxes and we went out to sea. But the boxes fell into the ocean in an accident.
